sn21.4:1.1: evamme sutaṃ ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkatāyati na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyā vaccaṃ karoti cīvarakārasamaye.
sn21.4:1.3: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā eka mantaṃ nisiṃdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn21.4:1.4: idha bhante aññataro navo bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkatāyissati na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karoti cīvarakārasamayeti.
sn21.4:2.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
sn21.4:2.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena taṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi satthā taṃ āvuso āmantetīti.
sn21.4:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
sn21.4:2.5: evamāvusoti kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno paṭissuṇitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn21.4:2.6: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkatāyissasi na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karosi cīvarakārasamayeti.
sn21.4:2.7: ahampi kho bhante sakaṃ kiccaṃ karomīti.
sn21.4:3.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā ceto pari vitakkamaññāya bhikkhū āmantesi
sn21.4:3.2: mā kho tumhe bhikkhave etassa bhikkhuno ujjhāyittha
sn21.4:3.3: eso kho bhikkhave bhikkhu catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasira lābhī yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
sn21.4:4.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
